Add scripts/smoke-groq-sdk.js: require('groq-sdk') (default and named Groq), build a client with a custom fetch, then check (1) chat.completions.create({model, messages, stream:true, max_completion_tokens}, {maxRetries:0, timeout:15000, signal}).withResponse() over a canned SSE body (a chunk with x_groq.id and delta.content, a final chunk with finish_reason 'stop' and x_groq.usage, data: [DONE]) yields both chunks and exposes response.headers (x-request-id, x-ratelimit-remaining-tokens); (2) a 429 with retry-after: 3 raises RateLimitError, status 429, err.error.error.code 'rate_limit_exceeded', and fetch was called once; (3) a 413 raises a plain APIError with status 413; (4) a mid-stream data: {"error":{...}} raises APIError with status undefined and err.error.type set; (5) aborting the signal mid-stream ends the iteration without throwing; (6) models.list() resolves on a canned list. Print the Node version and exit 0. Run it with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 under the installed Electron (Node 20.16) and under plain node. Run npm audit and record the result. tasks.description: Live probe (optional; needs the user's approval and GROQ_API_KEY; one tiny request per model, fractions of a cent). scripts/probe-groq-stream.js streams 'Reply with the word ok' through groq-sdk with maxRetries 0 to openai/gpt-oss-20b (reasoning_effort low, include_reasoning false) and to qwen/qwen3.8-27b (reasoning_effort none). For each chunk it prints only: index, ms since start, Object.keys of the chunk / choices[0].delta / x_groq, finish_reason, and whether usage is present. It never prints content or reasoning. Record the findings in research.md R17 and adjust FR-017 if usage arrives after finish_reason (plan risk table).

tasks.description: TEST streaming failover (groq.test.js). Fake groq-sdk via Module._load re-exporting the real 1.6.0 error classes. The fake stream is scripted chunks that honour signal and end quietly on abort, with an option to hang after the last chunk. withResponse() returns scripted headers. Cases: every SDK call receives maxRetries 0, timeout 15000 and a signal (FR-019); single model ok → content deltas, _final_model, [DONE], connection aborted at the finish_reason chunk even though the fake never ends (E44); 429 before stream on 1 of 2 → one _reset{next_model, reason:'transient'} at once, second answers (SC-003, E22); 503 twice on the only model → _reset 'retry', 2 s wait (retryRoundDelayMs), 'All Groq models failed (2 attempts, 2 rounds)' (E23); 429 retry-after 30 on every model → no second round (E24); 429 retry-after 1 → joins (E25); 413 TPM on 1 of 2 → _reset 'too-large', no cooldown (pickModel still returns it next request), second answers (E26); 413 only model → numbers message (E27), unreadable numbers → server reason (E28); 404 model_not_found → 'unavailable', 5 min cooldown (E29); 400 model_decommissioned only model → unavailable userMessage (E30); 400 invalid_request_error / 401 → no second call, '<model> — <reason>' (E32, E33); 422 → next model, not in round 2 (E34); mid-stream {error} after text → _reset, second answers (E36); x_groq.error chunk → STREAM_ERROR, failover, string not logged (E37); first-text timeout → 'timeout', 10 s cooldown, deadline cuts next attempt (E38, E39); deadline with models left → 'No answer within' (E41); streaming past the deadline not cut (E42); idle timeout after text but not before first text (E43); finish 'length' no text → failover (E45), with text → success stop=length (E46); stream ends with no finish_reason → transient (E47); delta.reasoning chunks ignored (E48); image routing: messages with image_url and list [gpt-oss-120b, qwen3.8-27b] → first call is qwen with the image, after a qwen 503 the gpt-oss call has no image part and logs images=dropped:1, request line order=vision-first (E17); cancel during attempt, after text and during the round wait → signal aborted, no error, request log cancelled (SC-004, E49-E51); enqueue after cancel does not throw (E52); all fail → 'All Groq models failed (n attempts). Last: …'; attempt log fields (ttft, chunks, stop, effort, tokens with reasoning and cached, queue, tpm_left, request_id from x_groq.id then x-request-id) present; no log line contains the scripted answer, reasoning or prompt text (C3, E61).
